reasoning: A hybrid approach combines autonomous reasoning to quickly identify plausible feature candidates based on domain knowledge of tumor characteristics, with external XAI tools to provide statistically robust, quantitative attributions. This ensures both domain-aware insight and model-verified importance scores, improving the reliability and interpretability of the final feature responsibility analysis.

autonomous_tasks.expected_output: Identification of features that are likely contributing to the benign classification due to their values

autonomous_tasks.query: Compare the input feature values to average or median values in benign vs malignant tumor datasets.
autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A set of features that show significant deviation in favor of benign classification
